segments.text: THE inclosed was sent by a young man, who was coming up to London, and was in his way as far as Ludlow, on purpose to wait on your Lordship about the contents of it. If your Lordship pleases, I will wait upon your Lordship for your Lordship’s answer. The character your Lordship has for candour and moderation, makes me believe, your Lordship will not favour any persecuting proceedings against those that love the LORD JESUS in sincerity. If your Lordship thinks proper to speak with me, upon the least intimation, you shall be attended by, my Lord,
Your Lordship’s most obedient son and servant,
